newsitem.title: EGYPT: Starch and Glucose gives H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Starch and Glucose gives H1 results.

text.p: Privatised company Egyptian Starch and Glucose said it made audited pre-tax profits of 17.693 million pounds ($5.2 million) in the first half of the financial year 1996/7, which began on July 1.
It compared this with pre-tax profits of 30.913 million in the whole of the financial year 1995/6.
Shareholders' funds at the end of the half-year period amounted to 73.040 million pounds, equivalent to 15.88 pounds for each of the 4.6 million shares.
The shares, privatised last year at 35 pounds each, closed at 57 pounds on the Egyptian stock exchange on Thursday.
